prediction_or_prohibition: ICP must add a prediction compression invariant or prohibition beyond a fully specified standard dynamical or process model.
operational_constraint_measure: Predeclared complexity divergence or task-impossibility quantity
observable_future_object: Held-out intervention-response family or transformation outcome
intervention_or_comparison: Fair nested model comparison under identical Pi A B and horizon
null_or_rival_model: Complete-state ordinary dynamics and redescription R001
required_controls: Same data budget model capacity boundary interventions and target
failure_threshold: No preregistered measurable or formal gain
outcome_if_failed: Treat ICP as a synthesis or heuristic rather than a new principle.

prediction_or_prohibition: Manipulating the proposed physical carrier should alter the future-law family in the specified way.
system_and_scale: Carrier identified at a declared physical scale
operational_constraint_measure: Distance between future-law families before and after carrier manipulation
observable_future_object: Path or outcome distributions under randomized interventions
intervention_or_comparison: Erase replace or perturb M while holding ordinary confounds fixed
required_controls: Material energetic geometric boundary assignment and sham-intervention controls
failure_threshold: Carrier manipulation has no predicted effect within adequate power and measurement sensitivity
outcome_if_failed: Reject or narrow the claimed causal role of that carrier.

prediction_or_prohibition: The proposed ICP equivalence or measure should be stable across declared physically equivalent representations.
system_and_scale: Selected system with a family of justified partitions and coarse-grainings
operational_constraint_measure: Equivalence-class or measure stability with tolerance
observable_future_object: Same operational future-law family expressed in each representation
intervention_or_comparison: Vary factorization observable algebra time resolution and coarse-graining
required_controls: Predeclared equivalence transformations and matched predictive target
failure_threshold: Measure changes arbitrarily while physical predictions remain equivalent
outcome_if_failed: Restrict ICP to an indexed observer/task level or revise the measure.

prediction_or_prohibition: Systems assigned the same M should have the same declared future-law family absent a missing variable.
system_and_scale: Classical or quantum process at declared horizon
operational_constraint_measure: Maximum distance across P^pi(F|M) within an M class
intervention_or_comparison: Prepare distinct histories assigned the same M and randomize identical interventions
required_controls: Matched boundary operation span and adequate sampling
failure_threshold: Systematic out-of-sample inequivalence above preregistered tolerance
outcome_if_failed: M is insufficient; add variables or abandon the equivalence class.

prediction_or_prohibition: A transformation prohibited by a formal ICP version should not occur under the stated resources and tolerance.
system_and_scale: Declared substrate constructor and resource regime
operational_constraint_measure: Operational task error and repeatability deterioration
intervention_or_comparison: Attempt the prohibited transformation with adversarial constructors and resource accounting
required_controls: Predeclared task attributes accuracy error model resources and replication
failure_threshold: Prohibited task occurs reproducibly beyond the declared tolerance
outcome_if_failed: Falsify that formal version or its stated scope.

prediction_or_prohibition: A claimed irreducible history effect should survive adequate enlargement of the state or be explicitly restricted to a reduced description.
system_and_scale: Reduced and enlarged descriptions of the same process
operational_constraint_measure: Residual conditional dependence or held-out predictive gain from history
observable_future_object: Future process after a causal break
intervention_or_comparison: Progressively add environment or latent state and compare Markov adequacy
required_controls: Matched interventions resolution regularization and model adequacy tests
failure_threshold: History effect disappears in an empirically sufficient enlarged state
outcome_if_failed: Narrow the claim to representation-dependent memory; do not infer fundamental inheritance.

prediction_or_prohibition: A claimed power-law range must have adequate absolute fit after likelihood-based estimation and cutoff uncertainty.
operational_constraint_measure: Discrete MLE exponent support cutoff and refitted bootstrap discrepancy
observable_future_object: Type-count distribution on the preregistered support
intervention_or_comparison: Semiparametric or parametric bootstrap with all selected parameters refit
null_or_rival_model: Lognormal stretched exponential cutoff-power-law and sampling-artifact rivals R011
required_controls: Frozen estimand tokenizer aggregation and enough independent tail units
failure_threshold: Bootstrap goodness of fit fails at the preregistered threshold or tail information is inadequate
outcome_if_failed: Label the curve rejected or inconclusive; do not use it as mechanistic evidence.

prediction_or_prohibition: The favored mechanism must predict sequential outcomes beyond the final rank-frequency marginal.
operational_constraint_measure: Held-out sequential log score novelty hazard successor-support score and calibration
observable_future_object: Next event innovation or reachable successor set
intervention_or_comparison: Compare original token-shuffled and block-shuffled sequences with the final count multiset fixed
null_or_rival_model: IID random typing fixed categorical and order-insensitive accounts R008
required_controls: Same marginal counts sequence length boundaries and model capacity
failure_threshold: No reproducible out-of-sample advantage or original-shuffle difference at the declared effect size
outcome_if_failed: Reject the history-sensitive mechanism for this system; retain Zipf as descriptive only.

prediction_or_prohibition: A claimed intrinsic history or criticality effect must survive preregistered conditioning on plausible common inputs and document heterogeneity.
operational_constraint_measure: Conditional scaling strength PEEV hierarchical variance and held-out conditional likelihood
intervention_or_comparison: Stratify or intervene on topic source part of speech stimulus sentence position or system state
required_controls: Adequate overlap frozen strata no post hoc selection and document-level uncertainty
failure_threshold: Effect collapses under a measured latent condition and no carrier-mediated residual remains
outcome_if_failed: Prefer the mixture account; do not call the pooled pattern inherited constraint.

prediction_or_prohibition: A stable mechanistic claim must remain dynamically coherent rather than appear only at one sampling depth.
system_and_scale: Growing corpus population or occupancy system
operational_constraint_measure: Cutoff ratio exponent number of types De Marzo coherence quantity and local Heaps slope
observable_future_object: Prefix and time-slice rank and discovery laws
intervention_or_comparison: Track frozen prefixes time windows and independent replication
null_or_rival_model: Transient undersampling and imposed-growth rivals R012; R014
required_controls: Separate observation effort from system growth and account for nested prefixes
failure_threshold: Scaling passes through Zipf transiently or claimed parameters drift outside the model's coherence relation
outcome_if_failed: Narrow the claim to a finite-window regularity and reject stable-law language.

prediction_or_prohibition: Criticality requires finite-size and perturbation behavior beyond a Zipf energy-entropy identity and must beat latent-mixture controls.
system_and_scale: Interacting multivariate system across declared sizes
operational_constraint_measure: Heat capacity susceptibility correlation length and peak location
observable_future_object: Response distributions under coupling or common-input perturbations
intervention_or_comparison: Vary system size perturb couplings and narrow shared drive
null_or_rival_model: Latent-mixture and model-deformation rivals R009; R010
required_controls: Consistent subset construction adequate model fit and independent perturbations
failure_threshold: No convergent finite-size signature or the effect disappears under latent conditioning
outcome_if_failed: Reject intrinsic criticality as the explanation of Zipf in the tested system.

prediction_or_prohibition: If sample-space reduction is the mechanism the conditional reachable set must prune directionally and predict held-out paths better than static grammar or topology.
operational_constraint_measure: Successor-support nestedness directionality reset law and sequential log score
observable_future_object: Conditional successor set and path distribution
intervention_or_comparison: Shuffle reverse and perturb the proposed ordering or reset process
null_or_rival_model: Static grammar topology and topic rival R013
required_controls: Matched vocabulary boundaries source position and model capacity
failure_threshold: Nestedness is absent nonpredictive or fully explained by a static order-free model
outcome_if_failed: Reject SSR as the mechanism even if the marginal remains Zipf-like.

prediction_or_prohibition: PSA occupancy claims must use a single declared spatial resolution or an explicit hierarchical survival model and must account for routing-trigger censoring.
system_and_scale: PSA semantic field at frozen frame calibration and grid policy
operational_constraint_measure: Common-resolution cell mass or event-level routing likelihood with subdivision state
observable_future_object: Cell arrivals novelty and successor paths
intervention_or_comparison: Reconstruct ancestors or analyze uncensored arrival events; vary grid frame and subdivision policy
required_controls: No mixed L1/L2 counts naive rank fit; preserve document source and calibration metadata
failure_threshold: Result depends on the adaptive heat threshold or disappears under common-resolution reconstruction
outcome_if_failed: Classify the original mixed-level Zipf curve as an artifact and redesign the analysis.
